title: Table 5-2: Description for status of indicator light of rectifier (REC)
markdown:
Table 5-3: Description for status of indicator light of battery (BATT)

| Green and on       | Battery discharges normally                                                |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Green and flashing | Battery low voltage discharge or battery is taking manual maintenance test |
| Red and on         | Battery is in fault (fault of battery or no battery)                       |
| Off                | Battery is being charged.                                                  |
